Future research and innovation funding opportunities

This timeline lists planned opportunities by anticipated launch month across all of UKRI’s funding councils, including Innovate UK.

The opportunities listed are still under development and some details may change. Not all upcoming funding opportunities will be listed on this page in advance. When the opportunity launches, further details including eligibility, funding duration and closing dates will be available in the funding finder.

UKRI expects standard funding opportunities to be open for a minimum of eight weeks from the launch date to ensure fairness and give applicants adequate time to prepare proposals.

Opportunities always open to applications are not included on this page.

Search for open funding opportunities

The information on this page is correct as of September 2026. The next update will be in December 2026.

September 2026

Artificial Intelligence: Enabling AI adoption across science and engineering

Funding seeks to support ambitious and exploratory projects with the potential to unlock new opportunities for applying artificial intelligence (AI) to important research challenges in priority science and engineering disciplines.

Part of the IS-8 Priority Programme.

Funding information: total fund of £5 million, maximum award of £195,160 (80% FEC) still to be confirmed

Lead: UKRI

Bioinformatics and Biological Resources Fund

Funding to implement, improve or consolidate bioinformatics or biological resources in support of UK bioscience, helping to drive forwards progress in bioscience research and innovation.

Funding information: maximum award of £2 million

Lead: BBSRC

Contract for Innovation: Innovation in play to improve child outcomes

Funding for organisations to develop practical solutions that reignite the importance of play and increase access to high-quality, real-world play environments and experiences to improve the learning and development outcomes of children and young people.

Part of the Research and Development Missions Accelerator Programme.

Funding information: total fund of £3 million with a maximum award of £500,000

Lead: ESRC

Economic Statistics Centre of Excellence 2027 to 2030

Invite only. Supports the advancement of economic measurement through improved methods, data collection, and analysis to deliver more accurate insights. Delivered in partnership with the Office for National Statistics, it supports the development of economic statistics and informs economic policymaking.

Funding information: funding amounts to be confirmed

Lead: ESRC

Engineering Biology: collaborative research and development

Funding to enable high growth potential engineering biology businesses to work across a supply chain with end-users in a range of engineering biology relevant application areas to take forward technologies and solutions, progressing towards commercialisation.

Part of the IS-8 Priority Programme.

Funding information: total fund of £12.5 million with a maximum award of £2 million

Lead: UKRI

EPSRC Physical Sciences National Research Facilities portfolio refresh

Invite only funding opportunity to support National Research Facilities for research across EPSRC Physical Sciences. Facilities may be based outside the UK for national use. Up to five years of funding available and you must demonstrate long-term financial sustainability.

Funding information: total fund of £15 million, maximum award subject to agreement with EPSRC

Lead: EPSRC

National Security and Defence: doctoral focal award in chemical threat reduction

Funding to deliver a doctoral focal award offering high quality, cohort-based doctoral training in chemical threat reduction skills related to the defence section of the government’s Industrial Strategy and the protection of UK national security.

Part of the IS-8 Priority Programme.

Funding information: to be confirmed

Lead: UKRI

National Security and Defence: National Research and Training Hub for Electromagnetic Environment

Funding to deliver a research and training hub, offering both high quality research and cohort-based doctoral training in electromagnetic environment skills related to the defence section of the government’s Industrial Strategy and the protection of UK national security.

Part of the IS-8 Priority Programme.

Funding information: one award of £14 million

Lead: UKRI

Quantum Technologies: National Quantum Strategy Mission 2 – components, systems and architectures

Funding to advance the research capabilities to deliver National Quantum Strategy Mission 2, strengthening the UK’s leadership in quantum networking and communications and accelerating progress towards the world’s most advanced quantum network and the future quantum internet.

Part of the IS-8 Priority Programme.

Funding information: total fund of £10.5 million with a maximum award value of around £2 million

Lead: UKRI

Quantum Technologies: National Quantum Strategy Networking Mission 2 – Research, Industry Coordination Network

Funding to establish a national coordination network supporting National Quantum Strategy Mission 2. The network will bring together researchers, industry partners and network operators to accelerate progress towards secure, scalable quantum communications and the future quantum internet.

Part of the IS-8 Priority Programme.

Funding information: one award of £530,000

Lead: UKRI

October 2026

Advanced Manufacturing: Advancing solutions for critical mineral production and recycling – phase 1

Funding for pump priming research for up to 12 months, to explore, test and validate disruptive and transformative solutions for critical mineral extraction, processing, recovery, reprocessing, recycling or re-mining.

Part of the IS-8 Priority Programme.

Funding information: total fund of £1.5 million with a maximum award of £305,000

Lead: UKRI

Advanced Manufacturing: Manufacturing scale-up network

This network will have a community coordination function, the capacity to run events and a flexible fund for research in the areas of Automotive, Aerospace and Advanced Materials manufacturing.

Part of the IS-8 Priority Programme.

Funding information: one award of £5 million

Lead: UKRI

Advanced Manufacturing: Manufacturing scale-up programme

This programme will convert world-class research into repeatable, cost-effective and flexible manufacturing capabilities, delivering tangible impact for UK industry.

Part of the IS-8 Priority Programme.

Funding information: total fund of £10 million with a maximum award of £2.5 million

Lead: UKRI

ALERT 2026

Funding supports mid-range bioscience research equipment, including novel capabilities and upgrading or replacing widely used instruments. Equipment must be accessible to multiple users. Open to eligible researchers and Research Technical Professionals.

Funding information: this is an equipment only grant, awards range from £200,000 to £1.5 million

Lead: BBSRC

Capacity building: clinical research training fellowship

Apply for funding to reacquire research skills. This fellowship is open to applicants who are registered healthcare professionals.

Funding information: salary support and uncapped funding for essential, justified research‑related expenses and resources

Lead: MRC

Climate Adaptation, Environment, and Resilience: What Works Centre for a climate resilient UK

Funding for a What Works Centre for Climate Adaptation to transform how the UK adapts and builds resilience to the impacts of climate change. It will work with stakeholders to inform and accelerate evidence-based pilots and actions.

Part of the IS-8 Priority Programme.

Funding information: total fund of £26.4 million

Lead: UKRI

Climate Tech Investment and Scale: growth cohorts entry competition round 2

Funding to recruit ambitious businesses to join a Growth Cohort. The Growth Cohort will fund and support businesses to accelerate their ambitions to decarbonise concrete.

Funding information: total fund of £1 million over a maximum of 20 awards

Lead: Innovate UK

Collaboration for a Sustainable Future: enabling coordinating groups to identify barriers and create solutions

Funding for coordinating groups to convene communities to produce an output identifying barriers, challenges and potential solutions to institutional collaboration in England’s R&I system. This is not a research grant.

Funding information: total fund of £750,000 with a maximum award of £100,000

Lead: Research England

Collaboration for a Sustainable Future: pilots, and cross-UK innovation partnerships seed funding

Funding for higher education providers to pilot new institutional collaborations within the R&I system. This is not a research grant.

Funding information: total fund of £19 million with a maximum award of £5 million

Lead: Research England

Early independence: clinician scientist fellowship

An early independence fellowship to support career transition. This fellowship is open to registered healthcare professionals.

Funding information: salary support and uncapped, fully justified research‑related expenses

Lead: MRC

Engineering Biology: Foundational Technology Hubs

Funding to build national capacity in transformative foundational technologies, platforms and enabling capabilities that address critical bottlenecks across the design-build-test-learn cycle, to accelerate discovery and innovation in Engineering Biology

Part of the IS-8 Priority Programme.

Funding information: to be confirmed

Lead: UKRI

Engineering Biology: Mission Hubs

Funding to build engineering biology research capability in areas of significant societal importance, to accelerate the application of engineering biology technologies and deliver tangible benefits for the UK.

Part of the IS-8 Priority Programme.

Funding information: maximum award of £15 million

Lead: UKRI

Eureka Globalstars Japan 2027

Funding to support UK-Japan international business-led innovation collaboration. Innovate UK will support UK businesses to collaborate with Japanese and other Eureka country counterparts. Innovate UK is funding the UK partners only. Any funded projects require national funding body approval.

Funding information: total award of £2 million over a maximum of five awards

Lead: Innovate UK

Experimental medicine stage one and stage two

Apply for funding to investigate the causes, progression and treatment of human disease. Your project must include an experimental intervention or challenge in humans. Applications for stage one and an invite only stage two.

Funding information: uncapped, fully justified funding to support the project lead, research staff and essential research‑related costs needed to deliver the proposed work

Lead: MRC

Exploring the frontiers of environmental research

Small scale funding to allow researchers to explore new and exciting areas of environmental science and exploit new technologies and approaches in a dynamic way.

Funding information: total fund of £8 million with a maximum award value of £100,000 to £200,000

Lead: NERC

Farming Futures research and development fund: soil and water

Funding for collaborative projects that will develop new solutions to support UK farming to improve soil and water. These must address significant on-farm or immediate post farm gate challenges or opportunities.

Funding information: total fund of £25 million

Lead: Innovate UK

Frontier AI cross-cutting novel round 1

An initiative designed to strengthen the United Kingdom’s frontier artificial intelligence capabilities and reduce dependence on foreign-owned AI technologies. The programme addresses a range of interconnected market and system failures that constrain UK competitiveness, innovation, and long-term economic growth.

Funding information: £1.66 million over a maximum of five awards

Lead: Innovate UK

International Placement Scheme 2027

Fully funded research placements at leading cultural institutions in the US, Japan, China, and Sub-Saharan Africa. For early career researchers, doctoral-level research assistants, and Arts and Humanities Research Council funded doctoral students.

Funding information: total award of £405,000

Lead: AHRC

Knowledge Transfer Partnership: 2026 to 2027 Round 4

Knowledge Transfer Partnerships fund collaborative innovation projects between businesses and universities to deliver strategic change, develop new products or processes, and build capability.

Funding information: total fund of £9 million over a maximum of 68 awards

Lead: Innovate UK

Medical Research Council Centre of Research Excellence: round five outline application

Funding for a MRC Centre of Research Excellence (MRC CoRE) to tackle complex and interdisciplinary health challenges. Outline stage open to applicants with the capability to lead a major CoRE based at organisations with standard eligibility.

Funding information: total fund of £50 million with a maximum award of £26.25 million

Lead: MRC

NERC Climate Adaptation ICURe Discover

A part-time nine week online market exploration programme for researchers and technicians. Support for activities to explore the potential market of climate adaptation based ideas, increase market awareness and gain deeper understanding of potential technology applications.

Funding information: maximum award of £2,500

Lead: NERC

Professional doctorate: clinical research training fellowship

Apply for funding to undertake a PhD. This fellowship is open to applicants who are registered healthcare professionals.

Funding information: salary support and uncapped funding for essential, justified research‑related expenses and resources

Lead: MRC

Public Engagement Spark Awards 2026B

Funding to engage the public with Science and Technology Facilities Council supported science. Spark grant holders undertake high quality programmes of public engagement that inspire and involve target audiences. Opportunity will launch between October and December.

Funding information: total fund of £100,000 with a maximum award of £20,000

Lead: STFC

Resilient Cultural Heritage Partnership

Funding for UK researchers to collaborate with partners in Europe and beyond on interdisciplinary projects on the theme of cultural heritage and climate change.

Funding information: to be confirmed

Lead: AHRC

Semiconductors: doctoral focal award in Chip Design

Doctoral focal award in Chip Design, designed in collaboration with the Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade Semiconductors team and the ACT and Semiconductors Programme Board.

Part of the IS-8 Priority Programme.

Funding information: one award of £6 million

Lead: UKRI

Small medium enterprise champions: Frontier AI – phase 1

The Frontier AI SME Champions competition aims to advance state-of-the-art AI and machine learning in the UK by supporting SMEs to validate ambitious innovations that could deliver step-change capabilities and enable new products, services, or platforms.

Funding information: total fund of £3.1 million

Lead: Innovate UK

UK-Germany Bilateral: collaborative research and development Round 5

This funding is to support high-growth potential innovative UK companies in aligned IS8 sectors and frontier technologies to grow and scale internationally through collaborations with German counterparts. Innovate UK is funding the UK partners only.

Funding information: total fund of £2.4 million over a maximum of nine awards

Lead: Innovate UK

November 2026

2026 to 2027 strategic longer and larger (sLoLa) full stage

Invite only. Investment to support large team-based fundamental bioscience research projects that push the frontiers of human knowledge.

Funding information: to be confirmed

Lead: BBSRC

Clean Energy Mission: Consumer-led Flexibility – Scaling Interoperable V2X (Vehicle to Everything)

Funding opportunity to target the scale-up of Vehicle to Everything (V2X) products and propositions so they are reliable, producible and market-ready for 2030, in both domestic and non-domestic contexts.

Part of the Research and Development Missions Accelerator Programme

Funding information: total fund of £18 million to be confirmed

Lead: UKRI

Climate Adaptation, Environment, and Resilience: Arctic frontier – accelerating innovation in ocean autonomy

Funding opportunity aimed at developing technological solutions to address the challenges of operating autonomous vehicles in the remote and exceptionally harsh environment of the Arctic Ocean.

Part of the IS-8 Priority Programme.

Funding information: total fund of £1 million

Lead: UKRI

Climate Adaptation, Environment, and Resilience: Arctic frontier: shifts in science

This opportunity will support a large-scale deployment of autonomous systems in the high Arctic Ocean, demonstrating how integrated surface and subsurface autonomy, AI-enabled mission planning, and rapid data delivery can advance knowledge, strengthen UK capability, and accelerate innovation.

Part of the IS-8 Priority Programme.

Funding information: total fund of £1.5 million

Lead: UKRI

Economic and Social Research Council postdoctoral fellowship scheme

This scheme provides a career development opportunity for those in the immediately postdoctoral stage of their career, to consolidate their PhD through developing publications, their networks, and their research and professional skills.

Funding information: total fund of £6.8 million,  no maximum award for individual fellowships but costs are limited to salary, associated indirect and estate costs, and up to £7,500 for ‘other’ costs

Lead: ESRC

Hydrogen R&D competition

Funding opportunity to target innovations in the hydrogen for storage space, with a focus on technology agnostic innovations such as compressors, materials, sensors and supporting hydrogen storage scale-up within early 2030 timescales.

Part of the Research and Development Missions Accelerator Programme.

Funding information: total fund of £10 million to be confirmed

Lead: UKRI

Policy Fellowships

An opportunity for early and mid-career researchers to work on research related to a current policy challenge, while embedded within a UK or devolved government department, facilitating knowledge exchange between policy and academic sectors.

Funding information: award value depends on the types of partnership

Lead: UKRI

UKRI gambling harms research and innovation partnerships: phase 2

Open to phase 1 award holders only. This opportunity will fund programmes of up to £5 million over four years by supporting multidisciplinary partnerships to deliver evidence, insights and actionable solutions addressing gambling-related harms.

Funding information: total fund of £40 million with a maximum award of £5 million over four years.

Lead: AHRC

UKRI Research on Research Security Hub

The UKRI Research on Research Security Hub will be a national focal point for evidence generation, capability building, community development and innovation in research security. It will strengthen the evidence base for effective research security practice.

Funding information: to be confirmed

Lead: EPSRC

UKRI Translation: MRC Impact Acceleration Awards

Apply for single-step support in developing a new or repurposed medicine, medical device, diagnostic, or other medical product.

Funding information: maximum award £300,000

Lead: MRC

UKRI Translation: MRC Proof of Concept

Apply for funding to develop and test novel therapeutics, medical devices, diagnostics and other interventions. Stage one application and stage two invite only for applicants successful at an earlier stage one.

Funding information: uncapped, fully justified funding to support project leads, research staff and the research‑related costs required to progress translational development

Lead: MRC

Wearables and Observables: understanding children’s home learning environments

Funding to support innovative approaches to evaluating children’s home learning environments. Generating new insights into the experiences, behaviours and conditions that shape children’s learning and development at home, while advancing the tools, methods and technologies available for measuring them.

Part of the Research and Development Missions Accelerator Programme.

Funding information: total fund of £3.75 million over four or five awards

Lead: ESRC

December 2026

Astronomy observation and theory small awards 2027

Funding to support theory, including modelling, simulation and related software development, observation, experiment and new technology research, relevant to all aspects of astronomy and astrophysics beyond the solar system.

Funding information: to be confirmed

Lead: STFC

Astronomy solar and planetary small awards 2027

Funding to support theory, including modelling, simulation and related software development, observation, experiment and new technology research, relevant to all aspects of solar system science

Funding information: to be confirmed

Lead: STFC

BBSRC flexible talent mobility accounts

Institutional awards for cross-sector and interdisciplinary knowledge exchange. They enable secondments and professional development opportunities for research, technical and professional services staff at all career stages, while building partnerships between organisations.

Funding information: total fund of £3 million over three years to support around 10 awards

Lead: BBSRC

Climate Adaptation, Environment, and Resilience: Ice-free arctic ocean

Funding to progress understanding of the environmental impacts of an ice-free Arctic Ocean, developing capability and capacity to build resilience and security. It will capitalise on polar marine multidisciplinary researchers and infrastructures of the UK, Norwegian and international funding partners.

Part of the IS-8 Priority Programme.

Funding information: total fund of £10 million

Lead: UKRI

Doctoral focal award: UKRI venture doctorates

One to three new doctoral focal awards that combine training in research with training in entrepreneurship, with the doctoral student making both a contribution to new knowledge and developing a new business.

Funding information: one award of £25 million

Lead: UKRI

Emerging transformative manufacturing technologies

Funding for new manufacturing ideas to be developed, tested, and validated in partnership with industry. Driving the next wave of industrial transformation (with the potential to reshape UK manufacturing) through short-term high-risk, high-reward projects.

Funding information: total fund of £5.6 million with a maximum award of £500,000

Lead: UKRI

Eureka Eurostars 3 Call 11 2026

Funding for SME-led industrial research and development projects that strengthen international collaboration through the Eurostars Network, enabling UK businesses to partner with organisations across 37 countries.

Funding information: total fund of £3.5 million over a maximum of 12 awards

Lead: Innovate UK

Frontier AI research and development consortia

The aim of this funding is to advance the development of frontier artificial intelligence, machine learning and foundation models in the UK.

Funding information: total fund of £50 million over a maximum of 10 awards

Lead: Innovate UK

Gravitational waves funding 2028

Funding to support UK ground-based gravitational waves research, including R&D, exploitation and maintenance and operations.

Funding information: to be confirmed

Lead: STFC

National Security and Defence Innovation Exchange (iX)

Funding to help solve challenges for revenue generating businesses already operating within the defence or national security supply chain.

Funding information: total fund of £1.5 million with around 30 awards

Lead: Innovate UK

Safer Streets Mission: Violence Against Women and Girls R&I Consortium

Funding to support ambitious, interdisciplinary research and innovation that will improve justice pathways for victim-survivors of violence against women and girls. Justice pathways begin at the point of first disclosure and extend across multiple systems and sectors.

Part of the Research and Development Missions Accelerator Programme.

Funding information: one award of £3 million

Lead: AHRC

Sustainable efficiencies in urban environments

This programme between UKRI and the National Natural Science Foundation of China will establish research collaborations in urban climate adaptation and resilience, drawing on UK and Chinese expertise in solutions for reducing the carbon footprint and increased climate resilience in urban environments.

Funding information: likely £1 to 2 million each, depending on discussions with partners

Lead: NERC

January 2027

AHRC Large Grants: full stage

This opportunity is invite only for successful applicants to AHRC Large Grants: outline stage. It will deliver world-leading excellent research that significantly advances knowledge and builds capability in their chosen area.

Funding information: total fund of £12 million with a maximum award of £3 million

Lead: AHRC

Capacity building: MRC clinical research training fellowship

Apply for funding to reacquire research skills. This fellowship is open to applicants who are registered healthcare professionals.

Funding information: salary support and uncapped funding for essential, justified research‑related expenses and resources

Lead: MRC

Clean Energy Mission: Consumer-Led Flexibility – investor partnerships

Funding investor partnerships to accelerate AI and digital solutions for consumer led flexibility.

Part of the Research and Development Missions Accelerator Programme.

Funding information: total fund of £15 million, maximum award to be confirmed

Lead: UKRI

Creative Industries: clusters 2, wave 3: outline stage

Funding for four creative industries clusters that enable universities, businesses, policy makers and private funders to drive research, innovation and growth in the creative industries. The clusters create research and development commercial opportunities, strengthen regional capabilities and deliver real world impacts.

Part of the IS8 Priority Programme.

Funding information: total fund of £27 million with a maximum award of 6.75 million

Lead: UKRI

CyberASAP Year 11 phase 1

CyberASAP is a highly competitive pre-seed accelerator that equips academics with the expertise, funding, mentoring and commercialisation support needed to transform cutting-edge cyber security research into market-ready products, services and ventures.

Funding information: total fund of £1.07 million over a maximum of 26 awards

Lead: Innovate UK

Early independence: clinician scientist fellowship

An early independence fellowship to support career transition. This fellowship is open to registered healthcare professionals.

Funding information: salary support and uncapped, fully justified research‑related expenses

Lead: MRC

Early independence: MRC career development fellowship

Apply for an early independence fellowship to support career transition. This fellowship is open to applicants at the early independence career stage.

Funding information: salary support and uncapped, fully justified research‑related expenses

Lead: MRC

Eureka clusters 2026

Funding to support UK participation in industry-led international R&D projects through Eureka Clusters, fostering collaboration and innovation across technology areas including communications, low-carbon technologies, software, advanced manufacturing and electronics.

Funding information: total fund of £10.5 million over a maximum of five awards

Lead: Innovate UK

Life sciences: Future supply chains

Funding to accelerate the adoption of manufacturing and supply chain technologies that strengthen UK medicines manufacturing capability. By focusing on deployment the programme will help businesses scale, improve supply chain resilience and support commercialisation of next-generation medicines manufacturing technologies.

Part of the IS8 Priority Programme.

Funding information: total fund of £4.4 million over five projects

Lead: UKRI

MRC small molecule high throughput screen using AstraZeneca facilities

Apply for funding to run a high throughput screen using AstraZeneca’s compound library and screening robots.

Funding information: total fund of £1 million with a maximum award of £270,000

Lead: MRC

Nucleus Public Engagement Awards 2027

Funding to engage the public with STFC supported science. Spark grant holders undertake high quality programmes of public engagement that inspire and involve target audiences with stories of science, technology and facilities funded by STFC.

Funding information: total fund of £200,000 with a maximum award of £100,000

Lead: STFC

Professional doctorate: clinical research training fellowship

Apply for funding to undertake a PhD. This fellowship is open to applicants who are registered healthcare professionals.

Funding information: salary support and uncapped funding for essential, justified research‑related expenses and resources

Lead: MRC

February 2027

Future Leaders Fellowships: round 12

Future Leaders Fellowships are personal awards to support fellows to develop as impactful and influential research or innovation leaders.

Funding information: total fund of around £110 million, previous fellowships have ranged from £300,000 to over £2 million

Lead: MRC

National Materials Innovation Programme: collaborative research and development

Funding to speed the translation of advanced materials innovations towards industrial adoption in prioritised high growth and strategic opportunity themes.

Funding information: total fund of £12 million over a maximum of 18 awards

Lead: Innovate UK

March 2027

UKRI Translation: MRC Impact Acceleration Awards

Apply for single-step support in developing a new or repurposed medicine, medical device, diagnostic, or other medical product.

Funding information: maximum award of £300,000

Lead: MRC

UKRI Translation: MRC Proof of Concept

Apply for funding to develop and test novel therapeutics, medical devices, diagnostics and other interventions. Stage one application and stage two invite only for applicants successful at an earlier stage one.

Funding information: uncapped, fully justified funding to support project leads, research staff and the research‑related costs required to progress translational development.

Lead: MRC

April 2027

Clean Energy Investment and Scale: growth cohorts entry competition Round 3

The aim of this funding is to recruit ambitious businesses to join a growth cohort. The growth cohort will fund and support businesses to accelerate their ambitions to decarbonise concrete.

Funding information: total fund of £1 million between 20 awards

Lead: Innovate UK

Life sciences: Investor Partnership

Funding for small medium enterprises in the alternative models space to access a R&D grant from Innovate UK alongside matched equity investment from an approved private investor.

Part of the IS8 Priority Programme.

Funding information: total fund of £3.5 million over 10 projects

Lead: UKRI

Life sciences: Investor Partnership

Funding for small medium enterprises in UK medicines manufacturing to access a R&D grant from Innovate UK alongside matched equity investment from an approved private investor.

Part of the IS8 Priority Programme.

Funding information: total fund of £10 million over five projects

Lead: UKRI

Medicines Manufacturing Data Institute Phase 2

Invite only funding to establish the Medicines Manufacturing Data Institute aims to be a trusted, secure and federated national data hub, enabling organisations across the medicines development and manufacturing ecosystem to securely capture, share and use data.

Part of the IS8 Priority Programme.

Funding information: total award of £5 million

Lead: UKRI
